verdict.rationale: Grok is a broad AI platform (xAI API, workspace, and connectors), not only an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only client-side MCP support: Grok connects to users' custom MCP servers, sometimes via tunneling. There is no evidence of a first-party MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint that external agents can connect to, so client-side connector support earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
